glossary.Ask: A resting offer to sell. Best ask is the lowest visible selling price.
glossary.Bid: A resting offer to buy. Best bid is the highest visible buying price.
glossary.Limit order: Buy no higher, or sell no lower, than your limit. The remainder queues.
glossary.Market order: Trade now against available opposite orders. Unfilled remainder cancels.
glossary.Mid: Halfway between best bid and ask. Nobody promises to trade there.
glossary.P&L: Profit and loss from opening equity. The public mark values unsold inventory.
glossary.Partial fill: Only some requested units traded. A limit remainder may keep waiting.
glossary.Position: Units owned: positive is long, negative is short. Buys add; sells subtract.
glossary.Spread: Best ask minus best bid. It is a price gap, not guaranteed profit.
glossary.VWAP: Sum of each fill's price × quantity, divided by total filled units.
